h1: Amigo vs every AI interview copilot
html:
Compare

Honest, feature-by-feature breakdowns against the most popular AI interview tools — stealth, coding support, Buddy mode, and pricing compared side by side.

What is Amigo? Amigo is a real-time AI interview copilot for Windows and macOS. It listens to live video and coding interviews, transcribes the interviewer's questions, and streams personalized answers to an overlay that stays invisible to screen sharing and system process lists. Unlike subscription-based tools such as Final Round AI, LockedIn AI, and Verve AI, Amigo is pay-as-you-go — credits start at $15 for 2 hours and never expire — and its Buddy feature lets a trusted friend send live tips alongside the AI.
